SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "period_sorted"
FROM (with scd_perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency

	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select

		, case

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y

			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y

			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd

					and scd.split_level = 1

				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (

					and scd.split_level = 2

			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'

			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'

			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency

			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y

			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y

			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:

			select

				, business_date 
				, node_name

				, pnl_4yp_rc

			/* perf_top_down_monthly:

				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc

				, pnl_4yp_lc

	cross join unnest (

			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency

			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency

			, pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency

		from
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )

	) perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[

			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'

			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'

		/* VALUE */
		, array[

			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency

			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) perf_unpivot ( metric, value )

			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:

			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd

			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'

			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency

			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency

		from

		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )

		array[

			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'

		/* VALUE */

			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]

    "rmv_analytics"."program" AS "program",

    "rmv_analytics"."sub_program" AS "sub_program",
    "rmv_analytics"."tenor" AS "tenor"

  where "rmv_analytics" ."business_date" > '2024-03-28' and "rmv_analytics" ."department" in ('Total Fund Management','Active Equities') and portfolio_type ='IP'

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 02
		AND hour between 18 and 19
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-02 18:03:01'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

    select limit_name,

    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_breach = 'Y'

    group by limit_name,

    select *

    union all

/* QuickSight c4f334e3-6e80-4afb-8e50-6bc3b1ad87c7 */
SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "period_sorted"
FROM (with scd_perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency

			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:

SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "period_sorted"
FROM (with scd_perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' )
					and scd.split_level = 0 
				)
				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, case
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_BCPP_D' then 'Base CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D' then 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_TF_D' then 'Total Fund Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' then 'Base CPP Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD' then 'Additional CPP Value-Added'
			else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, node_name as pbor_node_name
			, "level" as split_level
			, time_weighted_return_rc as time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_lc as time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc as time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc as time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_rc as pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_lc as pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_qtd_rc as pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_qtd_lc as pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fytd_rc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fytd_lc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_lc as pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		from
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )
			and "level" = 1
	) perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), cmb as (
	select * from scd_perf
	union all
	select * from perf
), cmb_clean as (
	select
		cmb.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, case
			when period = '1D' then '1. 1-Day'
			when period = 'MTD' then '2. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '3. QTD'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '5. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '6. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from
		cmb
	where
		value is not null
		and business_date >= cast( '2019-04-01' as date )
		and not ( pbor_node_name in ( 'Active Equities', 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing' ) and metric_type = 'Return' )
)
select * from cmb_clean) AS "finsights_perf_returns_income_daily"
WHERE "business_date" > from_unixtime(cast(substr(cast(1748223935604 as varchar), 1, 10) AS bigint))

			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'

			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'

		/* VALUE */

			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency

			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

SELECT "id_model_portfolio", "InvestmentStructureLevel1", "InvestmentStructureLevel2", "from_date", "to_date", "from_date_total_market_value_pc", "to_date_total_market_value_pc"
FROM (/*

 */

	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date
	, sum( from_date_total_market_value_pc ) as from_date_total_market_value_pc
	, sum( to_date_total_market_value_pc ) as to_date_total_market_value_pc
from (
	select distinct
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
		, min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as from_date
		, max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as to_date
		, case 
			when mhl.business_date = min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end from_date_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.business_date = max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc 
		  end to_date_total_market_value_pc
	from 
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio

		and mhl.pool_name not in ( 'ACPP', 'BCPP' )
		and spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 is null
	order by 
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
)
group by 
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date) AS "finsights_control_holdings_unmapped_mp"

	row_number() over (partition by scd_transaction_number_primary_key order by business_date desc) as rn
	from trades_deals.scd_transactions tr
	where transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
) st
left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by abor_security_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from asset.enterprise_security
) es
	on st.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id
	and es.rn = 1

	and rcc_exchange_country.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes )

	and rcc_incorp_country.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes )

	from reference.scd_portfolio

	and rcc_trade_country.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes )

	and st.trade_date = stc.trade_date

	and rcc.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.reference_currency_codes )
where st.rn = 1 ) ds LIMIT 0

var.hierarchy_type,
var.hierarchy_node,

CAST(e.dv01 AS decimal(22,6)) as dv01,
CAST(f.pv AS decimal(22,6)) as pv
from (
select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, analytic_value as "var95", run_id from

where business_date = '2025-05-30' 
and benchmark_name = 'CSG_BM' and hierarchy_type = 'RISK' and hierarchy_node = 'Credit Investments'

( select run_id from dag_runs where dag_id = 'active_risk_dag' and business_date = '2025-05-30')
) as var
left join 
(select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, analytic_value as "mean", run_id from

radar_reporting_prod.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_dv01

with old_breached_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        max(business_date) first_breach_date
    from "risk_uat"."limit_utilization"
    where is_breach = 'N'
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
new_breached_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        min(business_date) first_breach_date
    from "risk_uat"."limit_utilization"
    where is_breach = 'Y'
        and limit_id not in (
            select limit_id
            from old_breached_records
        )
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
first_breach_date as (
    select *
    from old_breached_records
    union all
    select *
    from new_breached_records
),

    select limit_name,

    where is_alert = 'N'

            select limit_id
            from old_alert_records
        )
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),

    select *

    union all
    select *
    from new_alert_records
)

WITH MaxBusinessDates AS (
    SELECT
        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten) AS max_ist_bd,
        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM performance.scd_performance_seclvl) AS max_psl_bd,
        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite) AS max_secc_bd,
        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite) AS max_pcc_bd,
        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_securities) AS max_scds_bd,
        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_party_issuer) AS max_spi_bd,
        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite) AS max_epc_bd
        
)
SELECT
    psl.business_date,
	ist.investmentstructurelevel1,
    ist.investmentstructurelevel2,
    ist.investmentstructurelevel3,
    psl.aggregation_level_1 as model_portfolio_id,
    psl.aggregation_level_2 as quoted_currency,
    psl.aggregation_level_3 as scd_security_id,
    secc.esm_security_name,
    psl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency,
    psl.period_result_bottom_up_quotation_currency,
    psl.net_cash_flow_reporting_currency, 
    psl.net_cash_flow_quotation_currency, 
    psl.market_value_reporting_currency, 
    psl.market_value_quotation_currency,
    coalesce (pcc.epm_party_name, epc.epm_party_name) as issuer,
    upcc.epm_party_name as ultimate_parent
FROM 
    performance.scd_performance_seclvl psl
LEFT JOIN performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten ist
    ON psl.aggregation_level_1 = ist.model_portfolio
    AND ist.business_date = (select max_ist_bd from MaxBusinessDates)
    AND ist.investmentstructure IN ('CPPIB_F24')
LEFT JOIN reference.scd_securities scds
    ON psl.aggregation_level_3 = scds.abor_security_id
    AND scds.business_date = (select max_scds_bd from MaxBusinessDates)
left join reference.scd_party_issuer spi
	on scds.abor_issuer_id = spi.party_id
	and spi.business_date = (select max_spi_bd from MaxBusinessDates)
left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite epc
	on epc.party_id = spi.party_id 
	and epc.business_date = (select max_epc_bd from MaxBusinessDates)
LEFT JOIN cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite secc
    ON psl.aggregation_level_3 = secc.abor_security_id
    AND secc.business_date = (select max_secc_bd from MaxBusinessDates)
left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite pcc
	on secc.enterprise_party_id = pcc.enterprise_party_id
	and pcc.business_date = (select max_pcc_bd from MaxBusinessDates)
left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite upcc
	on coalesce (pcc.ultimate_parent_enterprise_party_id, epc.ultimate_parent_enterprise_party_id) = upcc.enterprise_party_id
	and upcc.business_date = (select max_pcc_bd from MaxBusinessDates)
WHERE 
    psl.business_date = '2025-04-29' limit 500

/* QuickSight */
SELECT ds.* FROM ( select
	lt.business_date,
	--ist.investmentstructurelevel1, --add all investment strucutre levels
	lt.pool_name,
	lt.id_model_portfolio,
	mp.model_portfolio_name,
	--add model portfolio table
	ist.investmentstructurelevel2,
	uppcc.epm_party_name as ultimate_parent_party_name,
	lt.parent_security_type_name,
	lt.parent_security_name,
	lt.security_type_name,
	lt.security_name,
	secc.cppib_currency_of_exposure_name as security_currency_of_exposure,
	secc.cppib_country_of_exposure_name as security_country_of_exposure,
	lt.total_market_value_pc,
	lt.total_market_value_qc,
	lt.balance_nominal,
	lt.leg_no
from
	holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough lt
left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite secc 
  on
	lt.enterprise_security_id = secc.enterprise_security_id
	and lt.business_date = secc.business_date
left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite pcc 
  on
	secc.enterprise_party_id = pcc.enterprise_party_id
	and pcc.business_date = secc.business_date
left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite uppcc 
  on
	pcc.ultimate_parent_enterprise_party_id = uppcc.enterprise_party_id
	and uppcc.business_date = pcc.business_date
left join performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten ist
on
	ist.model_portfolio = lt.id_model_portfolio
	and ist.business_date = cast(lt.business_date as varchar)
left join reference.scd_model_portfolio mp 
  on
	lt.id_model_portfolio = mp.model_portfolio_id
	and mp.business_date = (
	select
		max(business_date)
	from
		reference.scd_model_portfolio
  )
where
	lt.business_date > date('2025-03-31')
limit 100 ) ds LIMIT 0

/* cppi::6736c8dee166230d79640ca1cc9a5073d2eb4c82b2f10fae35cebb704f489e1c */
select last_day_of_month(business_date) as business_date,
	currency_code,
    null vendor_code,
	avg(perusd_sr) as perusd_sr,
	avg(perusd_1m) as perusd_1m,
	avg(percad_sr) as percad_sr,
	avg(percad_1m) as percad_1m,
    max(arrival_time) as arrival_time
from
  (select business_date, currency_code, perusd_sr, perusd_1m, percad_sr, percad_1m, arrival_time,
   	row_number() over (partition by business_date, currency_code order by arrival_time desc) as rn
  from market.fx_rate
  where business_date between date '1982-08-31' and date '2025-04-01'
    and last_day_of_month(business_date) <= date '2025-04-01'
    and to_date(substring(cast(arrival_time as varchar), 1, 8), 'yyyymmdd') <= date '2025-04-01' ) as fx
where rn = 1
group by
	last_day_of_month(fx.business_date),
	currency_code

/* cppi::02925a812952842820f5931c09459926b9481b4f15c6890d6ff05605c12aeffa */
SELECT DLY.currency,
  CASE 
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN TWR_CAD <= -1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN -1
    ELSE EXP(SUM(LN(1 + TWR_CAD))) - 1
  END AS TWR_CAD
  from
(select business_date,
currency ,
	sum(market_value_cad) market_value_cad,
	sum(market_value_cad_t_1) market_value_cad_t_1,
	sum(cash_flow_cad) cash_flow_cad,
	sum(pnl_cad) pnl_cad,
	sum(pnl_local) pnl_local,
	sum(pnl_currency) pnl_currency,
	sum(pnl_currency_exposure_fx) pnl_currency_exposure_fx,
	sum(pnl_local_exposure_fx) pnl_local_exposure_fx,
	coalesce(sum(pnl_cad)/nullif(sum(market_value_cad_t_1),0),0) TWR_CAD,
coalesce(sum(pnl_local)/nullif(sum(market_value_cad_t_1),0),0) TWR_Local,
	(1+coalesce(sum(pnl_cad)/nullif(sum(market_value_cad_t_1),0),0))/(1+coalesce(sum(pnl_local)/nullif(sum(market_value_cad_t_1),0),0)) -1 TWR_Currency
	from performance.pace_holding_pnl
where performance_configuration_id in ('PC-POOLS')
	and model_portfolio_code is not null
	and component_type not in (
		'Cash',
		'Spot',
		'Constituent from original',
		'Constituent from spot',
		'Constituent from generic decomposition',
		'Residual from generic decomposition'
	)
	and cash_state not in ('Settled cash', 'Unsettled cash')
	and business_date  between  date'2024-04-01' and date'2024-04-30'
group by business_date,currency) as DLY
group by currency 
order by currency
LIMIT 200

    ELSE EXP(SUM(LN(1 + TWR_CAD))) - 1
  END AS TWR_CAD,
  sum(pnl_cad) pnl_cad
  from
(select business_date,
currency ,
	sum(market_value_cad) market_value_cad,
	sum(market_value_cad_t_1) market_value_cad_t_1,
	sum(cash_flow_cad) cash_flow_cad,
	sum(pnl_cad) pnl_cad,

	sum(pnl_currency) pnl_currency,
	sum(pnl_currency_exposure_fx) pnl_currency_exposure_fx,

SELECT

	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 02
		AND hour between 08 and 09
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-02 08:33:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC

FROM (WITH original_data AS (
    SELECT 
        data_date, 
        vendor, 
        currency, 
        exchange_rate, 
        is_exchange_holiday_flag, 
        year_month,
        'CAD' AS base_currency
    FROM 
        market.cppib_market_exchange_rate_cad
),
inverse_data AS (
    SELECT 
        data_date, 
        vendor, 
        'CAD' AS currency, 
        1 / exchange_rate AS exchange_rate, 
        is_exchange_holiday_flag, 
        year_month,
        currency AS base_currency
    FROM 
        market.cppib_market_exchange_rate_cad
)
SELECT * FROM original_data
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM inverse_data
WHERE NOT (currency = 'CAD' AND base_currency = 'CAD')) AS "FX Rates - CAD"

/* cppi::fc566736cb2dc976f89d99524eb749fc99f7a848f85c0fe9bddd3914cb120442 */
SELECT *
        FROM (
		    SELECT
		        currencyCode,
			    date,
			    MAX(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
				    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
				    grouped_usd,
				    data_diff
			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,
					currencyToCadRate,
					currencyToUsdRate,
					COUNT(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_cad,
					COUNT(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_usd,
					date - LAG(date, 3) OVER(
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as data_diff
				FROM (
						SELECT erc.data_date AS date,
								erc.currency AS currencyCode,
								erc.exchange_rate AS currencyToCadRate,
								erd.exchange_rate AS currencyToUsdRate,
								erc.is_exchange_holiday_flag as holiday_flag
						FROM cppib_market_exchange_rate_cad erc
								LEFT JOIN cppib_market_exchange_rate erd
								ON erc.data_date = erd.data_date
								AND erc.vendor = erd.vendor
								AND erc.currency = erd.currency

with risk_hierarchy as (
	select business_date,
		dim_hierarchy_node_id,
		node_level,
		(
			case
				when node_level = 1 then 'CPPIB-ALL'
				when node_level = 2 then 'DEPARTMENT'
				when node_level = 3 then 'STRATEGY'
				when node_level = 4 then 'PROGRAM'
				when node_level = 5 then 'SUB-PROGRAM'
				when node_level = 6 then 'MODEL_PORTFOLIO' else 'UNKNOWN'
			end
		) as hierarchy_level,
		'RISK' as HIERARCHY_TYPE,
		node_name,
		'' as account,
		'' as pool,
		parent_node_id,
		investment_dept,
		investment_strat,
		program,
		sub_program,
		model_portfolio
	from radar_reporting_prod.mv_dim_hierarchy_node_risk
	where business_date = '2025-05-30'
),
classification_secno as 
	(select inst_id, industry_sector_name 
		from asset.asset_instrument_classifications_latest class 
		join radar_reporting_prod.dim_inst i on i.security_number = class.id_holding_decomposition and i.business_date = cast(class.business_date as varchar) 
		where i.business_date = '2025-05-30' and class.holding_decomposition_id_type_code = 'SECURITY_NO'
		union all 
		select inst_id, industry_sector_name 
		from asset.asset_instrument_classifications_latest class 
		join radar_reporting_prod.dim_inst i on i.cppib_security_id = class.id_holding_decomposition and i.business_date = cast(class.business_date as varchar) 
		where i.business_date = '2025-05-30' and class.holding_decomposition_id_type_code = 'CPPIBSEC_ID'
	)
select 
	(
		case
			when dpi.portfolio_type in ('IP', 'CASH_FOR_BENEFIT', 'ACPP_CFB') then dpi.pos_source_system_key
			when dpi.portfolio_type = 'INDEX_LOOKTHROUGH' then replace(dpi.pos_source_system_key, 'CPPSECID')
			when dpi.portfolio_type = 'LOOKTHROUGH' and position('OFFSET' in dpi.pos_source_system_key) > 0 then dpi.pos_source_system_key
			else concat(substr(dpi.pos_source_system_key, 1, position('_' in dpi.pos_source_system_key)-1), '_', dpi.pos_short_desc)
		end 
	) as "position_key",
	currency.iso_currency_code "DV01_currency",
	curve.curve_value "DV01_curve",
	curve_type.curve_type_value "DV01_curve_type",
	dv01.data_source "DV01_data_source",
	term.term_value "DV01_tenor",
	coalesce((1 / fx.mid_val), 1) * dv01.final_value "DV01_cad_value",
	dv01.final_value,	
	dv01.initial_value,
	dv01.override_source,
	dv01.override_value,
	dv01.portfolio_type,
	dv01.scaling_type,
	dpi.maturity_date,
	dpi.pos_short_desc as "position_description",
	rh.model_portfolio as "scd_model_portfolio",
	rh.investment_dept,
	rh.investment_strat as "investment_strategy",
	rh.program as "investment_program",
	rh.sub_program as "investment_sub_program",
	dpi.cppib_product_type as "product_type",
	dpi.security_group_name as "product_group",
	(
		case 
			when i_rle.party_name is not null then i_rle.party_name
			when l1_rle.party_name is not null then l1_rle.party_name
			when mi_rle.party_name is not null then mi_rle.party_name
			else null
		end
	) as issuer_party_name,
	(
		case 
			when i_rle.gics_sector is not null then i_rle.gics_sector
			when l1_rle.gics_sector is not null then l1_rle.gics_sector 
			when cl.industry_sector_name is not null then cl.industry_sector_name
			when mi_rle.gics_sector is not null then mi_rle.gics_sector
			else null
		end
	) as issuer_gics_sector,
	cpr.rating_value as "issuer_final_rating",
	csr.rating_value as "inst_final_rating",
	(
		case 
			when dpi.isin is not null then dpi.isin 
			when inst1.isin is not null then inst1.isin
			else inst2.isin
		end
	) as isin,
	(
		case 
			when dpi.sedol is not null then dpi.sedol 
			when inst1.sedol is not null then inst1.sedol
			else inst2.sedol
		end
	) as sedol,
	(
		case 
			when dpi.cusip is not null then dpi.cusip 
			when inst1.cusip is not null then inst1.cusip
			else inst2.cusip
		end
	) as cusip,
	(
		case 
			when i_rle.secm_exposure_country is not null then i_rle.secm_exposure_country
			when l1_rle.secm_exposure_country is not null then l1_rle.secm_exposure_country 
			when mi_rle.secm_exposure_country is not null then mi_rle.secm_exposure_country
			else null
		end
	) as issuer_country_of_exposure
from radar_reporting_prod.fact_pos_calc_md dv01
	join radar_reporting_prod.dim_calc_currency currency ON dv01.dim_calc_currency_id = currency.dim_calc_currency_id
	and dv01.business_date = currency.business_date
	join radar_reporting_prod.dim_calc_term term ON dv01.dim_calc_term_id = term.dim_calc_term_id
	and term.CALC_DIM_TYPE = 'TERM'
	and dv01.business_date = term.business_date
	join radar_reporting_prod.dim_calc_curve curve ON dv01.dim_calc_curve_id = curve.dim_calc_curve_id
	and curve.CALC_DIM_TYPE = 'CURVE'
	and dv01.business_date = curve.business_date
	join radar_reporting_prod.dim_calc_curve_type curve_type ON dv01.dim_calc_curve_type_id = curve_type.dim_calc_curve_type_id
	and curve_type.CALC_DIM_TYPE = 'CURVE_TYPE'
	and dv01.business_date = curve_type.business_date
	join radar_reporting_prod.dim_pos_inst dpi ON dv01.pos_id = dpi.pos_id
	and dv01.business_date = dpi.business_date
	left join radar_reporting_prod.fact_fx_rate fx ON currency.iso_currency_code = fx.to_currency
	and currency.chron_id = fx.chron_id
	and fx.from_currency = 'CAD'
	and fx.rate_type = 'CROSS'
	and dv01.business_date = fx.business_date
	left join RISK_HIERARCHY rh on rh.dim_hierarchy_node_id = dv01.dim_hierarchy_node_id

/* QuickSight 829e7276-8269-48f5-87ac-2b2f2cb24a49 */
SELECT "id_model_portfolio", "InvestmentStructureLevel1", "InvestmentStructureLevel2", "from_date", "to_date", "from_date_total_market_value_pc", "to_date_total_market_value_pc"
FROM (/*
 * IDENTIFY UNMAPPED MPs IN HOLDINGS LOOKTHROUGH
 */	
select
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date
	, sum( from_date_total_market_value_pc ) as from_date_total_market_value_pc
	, sum( to_date_total_market_value_pc ) as to_date_total_market_value_pc
from (
	select distinct
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
		, min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as from_date
		, max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as to_date
		, case 
			when mhl.business_date = min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end from_date_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.business_date = max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc 
		  end to_date_total_market_value_pc
	from 
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion
		and mhl.pool_name not in ( 'ACPP', 'BCPP' )
		and spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 is null
	order by 
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
)
group by 
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date) AS "finsights_control_holdings_unmapped_mp"

SELECT "id_model_portfolio", "InvestmentStructureLevel1", "InvestmentStructureLevel2", "from_date", "to_date", "from_date_total_market_value_pc", "to_date_total_market_value_pc"
FROM (/*
 * IDENTIFY UNMAPPED MPs IN HOLDINGS LOOKTHROUGH
 */	
select
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date
	, sum( from_date_total_market_value_pc ) as from_date_total_market_value_pc
	, sum( to_date_total_market_value_pc ) as to_date_total_market_value_pc
from (
	select distinct
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
		, min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as from_date
		, max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as to_date
		, case 
			when mhl.business_date = min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end from_date_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.business_date = max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc 
		  end to_date_total_market_value_pc
	from 
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion
		and mhl.pool_name not in ( 'ACPP', 'BCPP' )
		and spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 is null
	order by 
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
)
group by 
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date) AS "finsights_control_holdings_unmapped_mp"

/* cppi::0a804232995867dc01b5bc3857548c0ee514cb1727685ef2fc5a590ba7ceb8c7 */
SELECT
  base.scd_holding_key_id,
  base.abor_security_type_name,
  base.abor_security_name,
  base.dirty_value_total_pc,
  COALESCE(lt.total_lookthrough_value_pc, 0) AS total_lookthrough_value_pc,
  ABS(base.dirty_value_total_pc - COALESCE(lt.total_lookthrough_value_pc, 0)) AS difference_pc
FROM (
  SELECT
    mh.scd_holding_key_id,
    mh.abor_security_type_name,
    mh.abor_security_name,
    mh.abor_holdings_leg_no,
    SUM(mh.dirty_value_total_portfolio_currency) AS dirty_value_total_pc
  FROM
    holdings.scd_holdings_main mh
  WHERE
    mh.portfolio_group_id IN ('ACPP', 'BCPP', 'CPPIB GROUP', 'SUPPLEMENTARY')
    AND mh.business_date = '2025-05-31'
  GROUP BY
    mh.scd_holding_key_id,
    mh.abor_security_type_name,
    mh.abor_security_name,
    mh.abor_holdings_leg_no
) base
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    lt.parent_holding_key,
    lt.leg_no,
    SUM(lt.total_market_value_pc) AS total_lookthrough_value_pc
  FROM
    holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough lt
  WHERE
    lt.business_date = DATE('2025-05-31')
  GROUP BY
    lt.parent_holding_key,
    lt.leg_no
) lt
  ON base.scd_holding_key_id = lt.parent_holding_key
  and base.abor_holdings_leg_no = lt.leg_no
  and abor_security_type_name not in ('IRS Interest Rate')
ORDER BY
  ABS(base.dirty_value_total_pc - COALESCE(lt.total_lookthrough_value_pc, 0)) DESC
LIMIT 100

select
     t. *,
     t.non_discounted_market_value as clean_market_value,
     t.non_discounted_market_value * fx_rate_quoted_in_cad as clean_market_value_pc,
     t.closing_market_value as market_value_mv,
     t.closing_market_value * fx_rate_quoted_in_cad as market_value_base_mv,
     t.current_notional as current_nominal,
     t.current_notional * fx_rate_quoted_in_cad as current_nominal_pc,

     ir.currency_code,

     ir.bloomberg_exchange,
     p.party_name,
     p.domicile_country_code,
     p.incorp_country_code,

     m.id_model_portfolio FUND_ID,
     m.id_model_portfolio,

where t.business_date = cast('2025-05-29' as date)

    index_ticker,

	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC

			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime

		AND day = 02
		AND hour between 20 and 21
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-02 20:41:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* cppi::e367997160fe1ce331670bda800dc98fff2d6db85414077b814fc4c00f66cc8c */
SELECT  
    psl.aggregation_level_1 AS "Model Portfolio Code",
    ist.InvestmentStructureLevel2 AS "Investment Structure Level 02",
    ist.InvestmentStructureLevel3 AS "Investment Structure Level 03",
    ist.InvestmentStructureLevel4 AS "Investment Structure Level 04",
    s.abor_instrument_type_id AS "Instrument Type Name - Current",
    s.abor_security_type_name AS "Security Type Name - Current",
    s.abor_security_group_name AS "Security Group Name - Current",
    s.abor_security_name_id AS "Security Name - Current",
    psl.aggregation_level_3 AS "Security ID - Current",
    psl.business_date AS "Frequency Period",
    pa.secpnl AS "Security PnL PC",
    pa.fxpnl AS "FX PnL PC",
    pa.totpnl AS "Total PnL PC"
FROM
    performance.scd_performance_seclvl psl
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT * FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten 
    WHERE investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
    AND business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten)
) ist
ON psl.aggregation_level_1 = ist.model_portfolio
LEFT JOIN 
    reference.scd_securities s 
        ON s.abor_security_id = psl.aggregation_level_3 
        AND s.business_date = psl.business_date
LEFT JOIN 
    reference.scd_model_portfolio mp 
        ON psl.aggregation_level_1 = mp.model_portfolio_id 
        AND mp.business_date = psl.business_date
LEFT JOIN 
    asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications asec 
        ON asec.cppib_sec_id = CAST(s.cppib_sec_id AS int) 
        AND asec.business_date = CAST(psl.business_date AS DATE)
LEFT JOIN 
    (
        SELECT 
            model_portfolio_code,
            security_no,
            security_id,
            business_date,
            currency,
            SUM(pnl_currency_exposure_fx) AS fxpnl,
            sum(pnl_local_exposure_fx) as secpnl,
            sum(pnl_cad) as totpnl
        FROM 
            performance.pace_holding_pnl
        GROUP BY 
            model_portfolio_code,
            security_no,
            security_id,
            business_date, 
            currency
    ) pa
on psl.aggregation_level_3 = pa.security_id
	and psl.aggregation_level_1 =pa.model_portfolio_code
	and date(psl.business_date) = pa.business_date
	and psl.aggregation_level_2 =pa.currency
WHERE 
    psl.business_date BETWEEN '2025-03-01' AND '2025-03-31'
    AND ist.InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Total Fund Management'
    AND pa.secpnl <> 0
    AND s.abor_instrument_type_id IN ('Bond', 'CD', 'CP')

		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-02 04:50:24'

) GROUP BY

-- 			WHERE C.CHRON_ID = LE.CHRON_ID
-- 		)
),
BUSINESS_DATE AS (
	SELECT *
	FROM SINGLE_BUSINESS_DATE
),
-- Select your date here

	SELECT FACT.analytic_value AS pv
	FROM BUSINESS_DATE bd,
		risk_prod.FACT_ANALYTIC_SD fact,
		risk_prod.dim_chron c,
		risk_prod.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE node
	WHERE FACT.CHRON_ID = c.CHRON_ID
		AND c.chron_ID = bd.chron_id
		AND fact.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID = node.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID
		AND fact.ANALYTIC_TYPE = 'PV'
		AND FACT.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = 'IP'
		AND node.node_level = 1
),
ACPP_PV AS (
	SELECT f.analytic_value AS pv
	FROM BUSINESS_DATE bd,
		risk_prod.FACT_ANALYTIC_SD f
		JOIN risk_prod.mv_dim_hierarchy_node_account h on f.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID = h.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID
	WHERE f.CHRON_ID = bd.CHRON_ID
		AND f.ANALYTIC_TYPE = 'PV'
		AND f.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = 'TOTAL_FUND_BY_ACCOUNT'
		AND h.ACCOUNT = 'ACPP'
		AND h.node_level = 2
),

	SELECT f.analytic_value AS pv
	FROM BUSINESS_DATE bd,
		risk_prod.FACT_ANALYTIC_SD f
		JOIN risk_prod.mv_dim_hierarchy_node_account h on f.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID = h.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID
	WHERE f.CHRON_ID = bd.CHRON_ID
		AND f.ANALYTIC_TYPE = 'PV'
		AND f.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = 'TOTAL_FUND_BY_ACCOUNT'
		AND h.ACCOUNT = 'BCPP'
		AND h.node_level = 2
),
CE_LE AS (
	SELECT PARENT.party_name,
		sum(coalesce(FACT.credit_exposure, 0)) AS credit_exposure,
		sum(coalesce(FACT.ACPP_credit_exposure, 0)) AS ACPP_credit_exposure,
		sum(coalesce(FACT.BCPP_credit_exposure, 0)) AS BCPP_credit_exposure,
		MAX(PARENT.gics_sector) AS SECTOR,

	FROM BUSINESS_DATE bd,
		risk_prod.fact_cr_exposure fact,
		risk_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity CHILD,
		risk_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity PARENT,
		IP_PV pv
	where fact.chron_id = bd.chron_id
		AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
		AND child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
		/* Exclude all north american government positions */
		AND NOT (
			(
				PARENT.is_government = 'Y'
				OR PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y'
			)
			AND PARENT.domicile_country_code IN ('US', 'CA')
		)
	GROUP BY PARENT.party_name
),
CE_LE_CN AS (
	SELECT sum(coalesce(FACT.credit_exposure, 0)) AS credit_exposure,
		PARENT.domicile_country_code AS COUNTRY_CODE,
		max(parent.SOVR_FI_LIMIT) AS SOVR_FI_LIMIT

		risk_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity CHILD,

		AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
		AND CHILD.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = PARENT.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
		AND UPPER(pos.product_type) <> 'NETTING'
		AND IS_POS_FI = 'Y'
		AND (PARENT.SOVR_FI_LIMIT IS NOT NULL)
	GROUP BY PARENT.domicile_country_code

			CASE
				WHEN PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y'

				WHEN PARENT.is_government = 'Y'
				AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'N'

				AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'N' THEN a_pv.pv * 0.03
				when regexp_like(parent.rtg_final, '(^B{1,2}[\+\-]?$|C|D)')
				AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'N' then a_pv.pv * 0.025
				/* BB and below */
				WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(PARENT.rtg_final, '^AAA[\+\-]?$')
				AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y' THEN a_pv.pv * 0.15
				WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(PARENT.rtg_final, '^AA[\+\-]?$')
				AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y' THEN a_pv.pv * 0.10
				WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(PARENT.rtg_final, '^A[\+\-]?$')
				AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y' THEN a_pv.pv * 0.075
				WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(PARENT.rtg_final, '^BBB[\+\-]?$')
				AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y' THEN a_pv.pv * 0.05
				when regexp_like(parent.rtg_final, '(^B{1,2}[\+\-]?$|C|D)')

				/* BB and below */
				ELSE -2
				/* Breach it big time, to indicate that a case was missed */
			END
		) AS ACPP_LIMIT,
		MAX(
			CASE
				WHEN PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y'
				AND upper(PARENT.party_name) LIKE 'PROVINCE OF ONTARIO%%' THEN b_pv.pv * 0.15
				WHEN PARENT.is_government = 'Y'

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 02
		AND hour between 02 and 03
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-02 02:40:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:

			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:

			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency

WITH RankedSecurities AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM reference.scd_securities
    WHERE business_date = '2025-05-29'
)
select a.*, b.*, d.*, e.*,pr.*, f.country_name, g.currency_name, h.*,i.rating_agency,i.rating_value,i.rating_type,i.rating_date
   from (select ss.portfolio_id as id_portfolio,
		 ss.model_portfolio_id as id_model_portfolio,
         ss.cppib_sec_id as id_instrument_new,
         ss.cppib_sec_id as id_instrument,
         'CPPIBSEC_ID' as instrument_id_type,
         ss.portfolio_id as id_portfolio,
         ss.scd_holding_key_id id_source_holding,
         null as id_enterprise_holding,
         sec.abor_security_group_id as instrument_sub_group_code,
         sec.abor_security_group_name as instrument_sub_group_name,
         ss.abor_security_type_id as instrument_type_code,
         ss.abor_security_type_name as instrument_type_name,
         ss.abor_security_name as instrument_name_source,
         ss.balance_nominal_number as current_nominal,
         ss.balance_nominal_number * ss.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency as current_nominal_pc,
         ss.accrued_interest_end_of_period_portfolio_currency as abacus_accrued_interest_pc,
         ss.accrued_interest_end_of_period_quotation_currency as abacus_accrued_interest_qc,
         ss.quotation_currency_code as current_notional_currency,
         ss.quotation_currency_code as market_value_currency,
         ss.clean_value_quotation_currency as clean_market_value,
         ss.clean_value_quotation_currency as book_value,
         ss.clean_value_quotation_currency as cost_value,
         ss.accrued_interest_quotation_currency as current_accrued_amount,
         ss.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency as fx_rate_quoted_in_cad,
         ss.clean_value_portfolio_currency as clean_market_value_pc,
         ss.balance_book_value_portfolio_currency as cost_value_pc,
         ss.accrued_interest_end_of_period_portfolio_currency as current_accrued_amount_pc,
         sec.abor_quote_factor as quote_factor,
         sec.abor_quote_type as quote_type_description,
         ss.exposure_portfolio_currency as exposure_pc,
         ss.clean_price as current_clean_price,
         '2025-05-29' as business_date,
         ss.quotation_currency_code as quoted_currency_code
		 from holdings.scd_holdings_main ss
		 left join RankedSecurities sec
			on ss.scd_security_id = sec.scd_security_key_id
		 where sec.abor_security_group_id = 'CD'
		   and ss.clean_value_quotation_currency != 0
		   and ss.business_date = '2025-05-29'
         ) as a
    left Join
         (select
          CAST(cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_sec_id_new,
          document_type,
          instrument_description,
          cusip ,
          isin,
          sedol,
          ticker,
          issue_date ,
          bloomberg_ticker_and_exchange ,
          bloomberg_unique_id ,
          coupon_rate ,
          coupon_type ,
          coupon_frequency_code,
          maturity_date,
          country_code as mds_country_code,
          exchange_name,
          region_code,
          market_sector_description,
          issue_country_iso,
          callable_flag,
          next_coupon_date,
          first_coupon_date,
          issue_date,
          par_amount,
          exchange_name,
          bloomberg_exchange,
          next_call_date,
          mic,
          issue_price,
          delete_date,
          cast(cppib_party_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_party_id_new
          from asset.asset_money_market
          where business_date = date'2025-05-29'
         ) as b
     on a.id_instrument_new=b.cppib_sec_id_new   
    left join
         (select
          CAST(cppib_party_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_party_id_new3,
          party_name, 
          bloomberg_company_id, 
          domicile_country_code,
          incorp_country_code
          from party.party
          where business_date = date'2025-05-29'
         ) as d
     on b.cppib_party_id_new=d.cppib_party_id_new3
    left join
         (select
          CAST(cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_sec_id_new3,
          cppib_country_of_exposure_code ,
          cppib_currency_code ,
          cppib_currency_of_exposure_code
          -- cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
          -- cppib_sector_classification_name_2,
          -- cppib_sector_classification_name_3,
          -- cppib_sector_classification_name_4
          from asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications
          where business_date = date'2025-05-29'
         ) as e
     on b.cppib_sec_id_new=e.cppib_sec_id_new3
    left join
         (select
          country_code,
          country_name
          from reference.reference_country_codes
          where business_date = date'2025-05-29'
         ) as f
     on e.cppib_country_of_exposure_code=f.country_code
    left join
         (select
          currency_code,
          currency_name
          from reference.reference_currency_codes
          where business_date = date'2025-05-29'
         ) as g
     on e.cppib_currency_of_exposure_code=g.currency_code
    left join
         (select 
     model_portfolio_key,
     id_model_portfolio, 
     unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
     from finance_accounting.model_portfolios
     where business_date = date'2025-05-29'
          ) as h
     on a.id_model_portfolio = h.id_model_portfolio
     left join
          (
               select rating_agency,rating_value,rating_type,rating_date,CAST(cppib_party_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_party_id_new4
               from radar_reporting_uat.cppib_party_rating
               where cast(business_date as date) = date'2025-05-29'
               and rating_agency = 'CPPIB'
          ) as i
     on d.cppib_party_id_new3 = i.cppib_party_id_new4
     left join
          (select
           CAST(cppib_party_id AS int) as party_cppib_party_id,
           cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
           cppib_sector_classification_name_2,
           cppib_sector_classification_name_3,
           cppib_sector_classification_name_4,
           cppib_country_of_exposure_code as party_cppib_country_of_exposure_code
          from party.party_enterprise_classification
          where business_date = date'2025-05-29'
          )  as pr
     on pr.party_cppib_party_id = cast(b.cppib_party_id_new AS int)

/* cppi::8490e91ab39bd81fc945a32e67a1d05e2c778c9684c7306a384e9b810ff4590e */
with 
	TOTAL_PV as
	  (
	    select fact.analytic_value as pv
	    from radar_reporting_prod.FACT_ANALYTIC_SD fact
	    join radar_reporting_prod.dim_chron c on fact.chron_id = c.chron_id
	    join radar_reporting_prod.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE node on fact.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID = node.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID and fact.chron_id = node.chron_id
	    where
		  c.business_date = '2025-05-30'
	      AND fact.ANALYTIC_TYPE = 'PV'
	      AND fact.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = 'IP'
	      AND node.node_level = 1
		  AND node.hierarchy_type = 'RISK'
		  and c.canonical_source = '1'
	  ),
	category_limits as
	  (
	    select 'FI' as category, pv * 0.3 as limit from TOTAL_PV
	    union all
	    select 'BBB' as category, pv * 0.0625 as limit from TOTAL_PV
	    union all
	    select 'BB' as category, pv * 0.0525 as limit from TOTAL_PV
	    union all
	    select '<= B' as category, pv * 0.0425 as limit from TOTAL_PV
	  ),
	WF_VW_CREDIT_EXPOSURE_MINI as
	  (
	    select
          parent.party_name,
          sum( case when credit_exposure is not null and parent.gics_sector = 'Financials' then credit_exposure else 0 end) as fi_ce,
          sum( case when credit_exposure is not null and regexp_like( parent.rtg_final, '^BBB[\+\-]?$' ) then credit_exposure else 0 end) as bbb_ce,
          sum( case when credit_exposure is not null and regexp_like( parent.rtg_final, '^BB[\+\-]?$' ) then credit_exposure else 0 end) as bb_ce,
          sum( case when credit_exposure is not null and regexp_like( parent.rtg_final, '(^B[\+\-]?$|C|D)' ) then credit_exposure else 0 end) as b_or_below_ce
        from
		  radar_reporting_prod.fact_cr_exposure fact,
          radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child,
		  radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent
        where fact.business_date = '2025-05-30'
          and fact.business_date = child.business_date
          and fact.business_date = parent.business_date
          AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
		  AND child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
          AND NOT ( (parent.is_government = 'Y' OR parent.is_provincial = 'Y' ) AND parent.domicile_country_code in ('US', 'CA') )
        group by parent.party_name
	  ),
	  summary_ce as 
	  (
	  select *
	    from
	      (
	        select
	          v.*,
	           sum(fi_ce) over () as sum_fi_ce,
               sum(bbb_ce) over () as sum_bbb_ce,
               sum(bb_ce) over () as sum_bb_ce,
               sum(b_or_below_ce) over () as sum_b_or_below_ce,
               row_number() over ( order by fi_ce desc ) as fi_ce_rank,
               row_number() over ( order by bbb_ce desc ) as bbb_ce_rank,
               row_number() over ( order by bb_ce desc ) as bb_ce_rank,
               row_number() over ( order by b_or_below_ce desc ) as b_or_below_ce_rank
	        from WF_VW_CREDIT_EXPOSURE_MINI v
	      )
	      CROSS JOIN UNNEST(
	        array['FI', 'BBB', 'BB', '<=B'], array[fi_ce, bbb_ce, bb_ce, b_or_below_ce], array[sum_fi_ce, sum_bbb_ce, sum_bb_ce, sum_b_or_below_ce], array[fi_ce_rank, bbb_ce_rank, bb_ce_rank, b_or_below_ce_rank]
	      ) as t(category, top_exposure, total_exposure, rank)
	     where rank = 1
	     )
	     select
	  ce.category,
	  total_exposure / 1000000 AS total_exposure,
	  limit / 1000000 AS limit,
	  ROUND( total_exposure / limit * 100, 1) AS limit_util,
	  case
	    WHEN limit IS NULL OR limit >= total_exposure THEN 'OK'
	    ELSE 'BREACH'
	  END AS status,
	  party_name AS top_issuer_name,
	  top_exposure / 1000000 AS top_exposure
	FROM summary_ce ce, category_limits cl
	WHERE ce.category = cl.category and limit IS NOT NULL AND limit < total_exposure
	order by case WHEN ce.category = 'FI' THEN 1 WHEN ce.category = 'BBB' THEN 2 WHEN ce.category = 'BB' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END

    s.abor_security_name_id as "Security Name - Current",
    pa.secpnl as "Security PnL PC",

from performance.scd_performance_seclvl psl 
--left join reference.scd_securities s on s.abor_security_id =psl.aggregation_level_3 and s.business_date =psl.business_date
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT * FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten 
    WHERE investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
    AND business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten)
) invstr ON psl.aggregation_level_1 = invstr.model_portfolio
left join (select * from reference.scd_securities
   where business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) from reference.scd_securities)
) s ON s.abor_security_id = psl.aggregation_level_3 
left join 
(select *
from asset.asset_security_identifiers 
where business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) from asset.asset_security_identifiers)
)asi on cast(s.cppib_sec_id as int) = asi.cppib_sec_id
left join 
(select *
from party.party
where business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) from party.party))p on asi.cppib_party_id = p.cppib_party_id 
LEFT JOIN 
    (
        SELECT 
            model_portfolio_code,
            security_no,
            security_id,
            business_date,
            currency,
            sum(pnl_local_exposure_fx) as secpnl
        FROM 
            performance.pace_holding_pnl
        GROUP BY 
            model_portfolio_code,
            security_no,
            security_id,
            business_date,
            currency
    ) pa
    ON psl.aggregation_level_3 = pa.security_id
    AND psl.aggregation_level_1 = pa.model_portfolio_code
    AND DATE(psl.business_date) = pa.business_date
    and pa.currency=psl.aggregation_level_2 
where 
    invstr.investmentstructurelevel4 IN ('Financing')
    And s.abor_instrument_type_id IN ('ALM', 'Bond', 'CD', 'Securities lending', 'Swap', 'CP')
    and psl.business_date >= '2025-03-01' 
    AND psl.business_date <= '2025-03-31'
    and pa.secpnl <>0
